Data auto-saves continuously in this browser. Use the Save button any time for a fresh confirmation, and see Settings → Data & Backup for a downloadable copy.

Settings

Data & Backup

The tracker auto-saves in this browser as you work. Download a backup file periodically, or restore from one on a new computer.

Claim Number Formats

Worked out from the jobs already on the board — not a list I wrote. A carrier needs 10 claims before its shape counts for anything, and a shape has to turn up twice before it's treated as a real variant rather than a one-off. Below that it's only watching.

Cloud Sync

PDFs and photos back themselves up automatically.

Collision Center Info & Rates

This is the letterhead on every printed invoice — your logo top-left, name and address centered, exactly like your estimate sheets.

Your Bureau of Automotive Repair registration. California requires it on repair documents.

A PNG with a transparent or white background works best. It'll be scaled to fit the top-left corner of the invoice.

The round badge in the top-right corner. This wants a square image — a wide letterhead logo squashed into a circle is unreadable, which is why it's a separate picture rather than the one above. Leave it empty and the circle shows the shop's initials.

Total Loss Rates

Starting rates on every new total loss job. You can still change any of them on an individual job.

Invoice Numbering

Invoice numbers run in sequence. A job gets its number the first time you print its invoice and keeps it forever, so reprinting never changes it. Set the last-used number if you're continuing an existing sequence.

Insurance Companies
Charge Types

Offered as suggestions under Additional Charges on a total loss. The price fills in when you pick one and can still be changed on the job.

Location Options
Columns

Tick a column to show it on the board. Hiding one keeps its position and width, so it comes back where it was. Drag the headers to reorder while the layout is unlocked.

Source Options

Where the job came from. Renaming one updates every job using it.

Status Options
Advanced Settings

Table Layout

Use the lock button at the top-right of the table to unlock it, then drag column headers to reorder them, or drag the edge of a header to resize. Lock it again when you're done.

AI Note Clean-Up

Paste an Anthropic API key to have the Clean Up button rewrite notes properly — fixing any typo and tidying the wording, not just known misspellings. Get a key at console.anthropic.com. It's stored only in this browser and is never included in backup files. Without a key, Clean Up still works using the built-in offline corrector.

Cloud Database

This tracker syncs automatically. Only change this if you're pointing it at a different Firebase database — paste the database URL or the full firebaseConfig block, then Connect.

Storage Check

Reports what's actually stored for attachments, and flags any job pointing at a file that's missing.

Scan VIN Plate

          
Snip the plate with Windows (Win+Shift+S) and press Ctrl+V here, or drop an image in. Every reading is checked against the VIN's own check digit and then against the federal database — only ones that decode to a real vehicle are offered.
